title: ReDoS in email validation regex
description: The email validation regular expression in validators.py is vulnerable to catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS). The pattern ^([a-zA-Z0-9]+)+@ contains nested quantifiers. An input of 30+ 'a' characters followed by a non-matching character causes exponential backtracking. On the current main branch I measured roughly 8 seconds of CPU for a 30-character input, scaling exponentially with length. A request carrying such an email field can stall a worker.
poc_text: from myproj.validators import validate_email; validate_email('a'*40 + '!')  # hangs
